title: An independent assessment of an artificial intelligence system for prostate cancer detection shows strong diagnostic accuracy.
summary: The trained Paige Prostate classifier scores whole-slide biopsy images against separately rendered pathology diagnoses. A 1,876-image independent-institution cohort and pathologist review of discrepancies support external diagnostic validation; poor-quality scans remain a limitation. The paper appeared in Modern Pathology. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
